en.headline: Discovery Bay holds Halloween Night Market and first cosplay parade today
en.dek: The free Halloween Night Market runs from 2pm to 9pm at DB Plaza Open Piazza today, alongside the debut cosplay parade and costume contest from 3pm to 5pm.
body: Discovery Bay is staging its Halloween Night Market today as part of the Spooky Chills programme. According to the organisers, the free market at DB Plaza Open Piazza runs from 2pm to 9pm and brings together around 60 specialty stalls offering handcrafted items, Halloween accessories and pet products, with a roving magician performing.

The same day marks the first Discovery Bay Cosplay Parade and Costume Contest. Shortlisted finalists will take part in the parade and contest from 3pm to 5pm in the outdoor area outside the main entrance of DB Plaza. Photo spots and installations across DB Plaza and DB North Plaza remain open through 1 November, with lighting from 5.30pm to 11pm.

Complimentary bus and ferry services are arranged for designated hours during the broader DB Fun Day events. The organisers said the programme is open to the public and aims to offer a family- and pet-friendly Halloween experience in the resort-style setting of Discovery Bay.

zh.headline: 愉景灣今日舉辦萬聖節夜市及首屆Cosplay巡遊
zh.dek: 免費萬聖節夜市今日下午2時至9時在愉景廣場露天廣場舉行，首屆Cosplay巡遊及服裝比賽則於下午3時至5時進行。
body: 愉景灣今日舉辦萬聖節夜市，屬「盞鬼」愉景灣2026活動之一。主辦方表示，夜市在愉景廣場露天廣場舉行，時間為下午2時至9時，設約60個特色攤位，售賣手工藝品、萬聖節配件及寵物用品，並有魔術師巡迴表演。
同日亦舉行愉景灣首屆Cosplay巡遊及服裝比賽。入圍者將於下午3時至5時在愉景廣場正門外露天區域參與巡遊及比賽。愉景廣場及愉景北廣場的打卡裝置開放至11月1日，亮燈時間為下午5時30分至11時。
主辦方安排指定時段的免費巴士及渡輪服務，方便市民前往。活動對公眾開放，主辦方指希望在愉景灣的度假環境中提供適合家庭及寵物的萬聖節體驗。
